unverified: Plain golf carts: Dare County map + town codes applied (KDH, Kitty Hawk, Southern Shores, Nags Head, Colington, unincorporated Roanoke Island: not on public roads; Duck: not on NC 12; Manteo: permitted road-legal carts, not on US 64). LSVs: state rule (posted <=35).

bans.label: US 158 / Croatan Hwy: 45+ mph, not an LSV road on the Dare County golf cart & LSV map (Nags Head: cross only at a traffic light)

sources: https://gis.darecountync.gov/golfcarts/ (Dare County GIS 'Where can you roll? Golf cart & LSV friendly roads', per-town rules)
https://nagsheadnc.gov/FAQ.aspx?QID=118 (Nags Head: unregistered golf carts not on town streets, Code Sec. 42-92(b))
https://ducknc.gov/golf-carts-in-duck/ (Duck Ord. 18-04: golf carts on side streets, not along Duck Road / NC 12)
https://www.kdhnc.com/DocumentCenter/View/14549/20221114_BOC_C1OB1Golf_Carts (KDH: no cart ordinance; Manteo Code Sec. 46-152: road-legal carts, not on US 64)

cart_only_bans.label: Dare County golf cart & LSV map: golf carts are not permitted on roadways in Kill Devil Hills (no town cart ordinance under G.S. 160A-300.6); LSVs on roads <=35 mph
Dare County golf cart & LSV map: golf carts are not permitted on roadways in Kitty Hawk; LSVs on roads <=35 mph
Dare County golf cart & LSV map: golf carts are not permitted on roadways in Southern Shores; LSVs on roads <=35 mph

Nags Head Code Sec. 42-92(b): unregistered low-speed motorized vehicles incl. golf carts may not be driven on town streets (only DMV-registered and tagged; Dare County map: golf carts not permitted on Nags Head roadways)
Dare County golf cart & LSV map: golf carts are not permitted on roadways on Colington Island; LSVs on roads <=35 mph
Town of Manteo Code Sec. 46-152(b): golf carts shall not be operated upon US Hwy 64 (cross only at a perpendicular intersection); permitted road-legal carts on other town streets <=35 mph
Dare County golf cart & LSV map: golf carts are not permitted on roadways in unincorporated Manteo (Roanoke Island outside town limits and Pirate's Cove); LSVs on roads <=35 mph
Town of Duck Ord. 18-04: golf carts may not operate along Duck Road (NC 12), only cross it at a right angle; side streets OK (registered, 16+)
